title: MagicFactory
description: Mod adding a new liminal space
body:
# About the Mod
The mod adds a new dimension - the Factory

This is an infinitely generating dimension consisting of many rooms separated by doors. You will have to develop and explore this creepy factory to beat Minecraft

The mod has a [wiki](https://magicfactory-minecraft-mod.fandom.com/wiki/MagicFactory_Wiki) to guide you

# Mod Settings
When creating a world, you can toggle Overworld accessibility (default: off) and chat access (default: off)

# Possible Issues
- The first dimension generation may take a while, this is normal

- If you get stuck in blocks upon spawning, run: "/execute in magicfactory:factory run place structure magicfactory:factory 0 0 0"

- Due to quirky generation, the world may be impassable. Don't hesitate to use commands in this case (also, if you didn't spawn in a room with a computer, I recommend finding it and starting the adventure from there)
